column1: Declare a reusable external model definition with {{c1::CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL}}.
column2:
This registers metadata without calling the endpoint or generating embeddings.
Review source

column1: Change external model metadata with {{c1::ALTER EXTERNAL MODEL}}.
column2:
ALTER uses SET (...) for changed options, while CREATE uses WITH (...).
Review source

column1: An external model's remote endpoint URL belongs in its {{c1::LOCATION}} option.
column2:
Remote external model endpoints require HTTPS with TLS.
Review source

column1: For Azure OpenAI endpoints, set an external model's API_FORMAT to {{c1::'Azure OpenAI'}}.
column2:
API_FORMAT tells SQL which request and response format the endpoint uses.
Review source

column1: The documented MODEL_TYPE for CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL is {{c1::EMBEDDINGS}}.
column2:
The current reference does not define a general chat-generation model type for this statement.
Review source

column1: Supply model-level JSON request options through an external model's {{c1::PARAMETERS}} option.
column2:
The endpoint and selected model must support the supplied options.
Review source

column1: For managed-identity authentication in Azure SQL Database outbound REST credentials, set IDENTITY to {{c1::'Managed Identity'}}.
column2:
This authentication method avoids storing a long-lived API key in the credential.
Review source

column1: To supply an Azure OpenAI API key through a REST credential, set IDENTITY to {{c1::'HTTPEndpointHeaders'}}.
column2:
Store the api-key header and its value as JSON in the credential's SECRET.
Review source

column1: Generate embeddings from description using MyEmbeddingModel with {{c1::AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS(description USE MODEL MyEmbeddingModel)}}.
column2:
MyEmbeddingModel must name an external model configured for embeddings.
Review source

column1: On SQL Server 2025, enable the {{c1::external rest endpoint enabled}} server option for remote AI endpoint calls.
column2:
It is disabled by default on SQL Server 2025, but enabled by default on Azure SQL Database.

column2:
Metadata visibility depends on the caller's access to the model.
